vulnerabilityAlerts.description: release-please hides `chore`, so a `chore(deps):` security fix would never cut a release on its own. `fix` makes it a patch release. These skip dashboard approval, so keep a person in front of the merge.

packageRules.description: Nothing on a PR exercises most workflow changes (release-please.yml runs only on main).
mise is dev-only (CI installs its own toolchains), so CI passing proves nothing about these. No mise.lock, so nothing for lock file maintenance to refresh.
clippy runs with -D warnings; a new toolchain can fail a green branch. Fix the new lints in the same PR.
Cargo.toml uses caret ranges, so in-range updates arrive as named PRs touching Cargo.lock only.
